en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a lush palm garden in a park setting, with several benches and ornamental plant arrangements. The title printed on the image reads 'Bad Pyrmont, Palmengarten im Kurpark' indicating it is a palm garden in the spa gardens of Bad Pyrmont. The reverse side includes handwritten correspondence in German, an address, and a clear postmark from Bad Pyrmont dated '21.1.18', as well as a printed mark from a museum in Schloss Bad Pyrmont.
